1.name: ArtRuso
1.title: Outdoor Furniture E-commerce Store
1.description: Specialized e-commerce platform for outdoor furniture: park benches, airport seating, school furniture, and public space solutions. Features 3D product viewer, custom configuration system, YouKassa integration, and dedicated B2B module for corporate clients.

2.name: Ergant
2.title: Furniture Online Store
2.description: Modern furniture e-commerce platform with extensive product catalog, advanced filtering by styles and materials, 3D interior visualization, installment payment system, and delivery tracking. Personal account with purchase history and customer review system.

3.name: Glincom
3.title: Real Estate Platform
3.description: Comprehensive platform for rental and purchase of various real estate types: residential, commercial, warehouse properties. Interactive property map, virtual tours, online booking system, YouKassa integration, realtor CRM, and market analytics module.

4.name: Go-Tver
4.title: Digital Tver City Guide
4.description: Interactive tourist guide with detailed attractions map, audio guides, walking routes, events and activities information. Mobile version with GPS navigation, location rating system, and personalized route creation feature.

5.name: Russam
5.title: Jewelry E-commerce Store
5.description: Premium jewelry and accessories online store with exclusive collections catalog, jewelry personalization system, virtual try-on feature, trade-in program, YouKassa integration, and authenticity certificates. Personal account with purchase history and wishlist functionality.

6.name: Window Continent
6.title: Full-Service Window Company Website
6.description: Corporate website for windows, doors manufacturing and balcony finishing company. Features 3D window configurator, cost calculator including installation, completed projects gallery, online ordering system, client personal account with order tracking from production to installation.

7.name: Zodiac
7.title: Astrology & Esoteric Mobile App
7.description: Comprehensive mobile application for astrology and esoteric enthusiasts featuring personalized horoscopes, zodiac compatibility, lunar calendar, Tarot cards, and meditation guides. Push notification system for important astrological events and personalized recommendations.

8.name: Starlotute
8.title: Telegram Star Roulette Game
8.description: Interactive gaming roulette in Telegram with star system, daily bonuses, tournaments, and player rankings. Colorful animations, sound effects, and achievement system. Secure gaming mechanics with anti-cheat protection.

9.name: Football Ivanovo
9.title: Telegram Mini App for Football Field Booking
9.description: Convenient Telegram Mini App for booking football fields in Ivanovo with interactive venue map, available time slots schedule, online payment system, and booking notifications. Calendar integration and team creation functionality.
